sentences.Å, hei! Hvordan har du det? Det er lenge: Oh, hi! How are you? It's been a long time since I've seen you. Have you left the class?
sentences.Ja, jeg har begynt på norskkurs om kveld: Yes, I've started an evening Norwegian course, because I've got a permanent job.
sentences.Takk, jeg er også glad for å ha fått job: Thanks, I'm glad to have got a job too. Ewa has come to Norway.
sentences.Så koselig! Når kom hun hit?: How lovely! When did she come here?
sentences.Hun kom hit for en måned siden. Vi har k: She came here a month ago. We have bought an apartment together in the city centre.
sentences.Så fint! Har dere flyttet inn?: How nice! Have you moved in?
sentences.Ja, vi flyttet inn for to uker siden, og: Yes, we moved in two weeks ago, and we have done up the living room, the hall and the bedrooms.
sentences.Så flinke dere er! Har Ewa fått jobb her: How clever you are! Has Ewa got a job here?
sentences.Nei, hun leter etter jobb nå. Hun har læ: No, she is looking for a job now. She has learned a little Norwegian, but she isn't very good at Norwegian yet. We try to speak a bit of Norwegian at home.
sentences.Det er bra. Har du snakket med noen i kl: That's good. Have you talked to anyone from the class lately?
sentences.Ja, jeg snakket med Sompit i går. Jeg ha: Yes, I talked to Sompit yesterday. I have also talked to Yousef many times. I miss the old class with all the nice people, but it's exciting with a new class and new colleagues at work.
sentences.Ja, og du har hatt mye å gjøre i den nye: Yes, and you've had a lot to do in the new apartment. Good luck in the new job, Marek!
sentences.Takk for det. Hyggelig å snakke med deg!: Thank you. Nice talking to you!
sentences.Nå har jeg endelig kommet til Norge!: Now I have finally come to Norway!
I came here a month ago.
sentences.Marek har fått fast jobb, og vi har kjøp: Marek has got a permanent job, and we have bought a nice apartment together.
The new apartment is in the city centre.
sentences.Det er en treroms leilighet på 70 kvadra: It is a three-room apartment of 70 square metres.
sentences.Vi har malt de mørke veggene i stua, og: We have painted the dark walls in the living room, and Marek has laid a new floor.
Now the living room is bright and nice.
sentences.Jeg har fått et lite skrivebord på det e: I have got a small desk in one of the bedrooms.
sentences.Det lille skrivebordet har Marek laget s: Marek made the little desk himself.
He is a very skilled carpenter.
